verdict.rationale: Enterprise or cloud-platform authentication is a fair question for a coding agent, so the axis applies. The pack only documents consumer model sources at onboarding (ChatGPT/Codex subscription, SuperGrok subscription, or Slate credits). It has no evidence of SSO/SAML, enterprise identity providers, or cloud-platform authentication such as Bedrock or Vertex.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
